acceptance: The versioned Operation Contract and linked Requirements-and-Evidence Record specify input/output roles, claim scope, operation parameters, and typed failure or abstention conditions; existing charter links are design references, not evidence that this milestone is complete.

The contract inherits foundations-record-validation, foundations-temporal-integrity, foundations-data-protocol and foundations-lifecycle-admission. Any not-applicable rule is justified; a reusable interface can be drafted before instance selection, but an admitted run binds every required dataset, provider, artifact and protocol dependency.

milestones.title: Implement the agreed operation interface
milestones.description: Implemented OR06-PCR-CPP 0.1.0 under code/operations/counterfactuals: a standard-library C++20 interface over recorded deterministic responses. It validates exact identities, pairing, scalar controls, supplied support/validity checks and temporal dependencies; computes finite paired contrasts; retains lineage and all failure/abstention/unresolved states. The managed-container source-bound run passed 47 engineering cases and independent review found no remaining correctness blockers. Upstream provenance attestations are caller-supplied. The separately admitted synthetic evaluation has its own milestone and verification; engineering fixtures alone establish no scientific or causal quality.

goals.title: Establish operation-specific evidence
goals.description: Use controlled or paired evidence where available; check confounding, overlap and validity before making intervention claims.

milestones.title: Define and execute the admitted evaluation
milestones.description: Completed prospectively frozen OR06-SYNTH-RESP-001 v1.0.0: three seeds with twelve TRAIN-only fitted synthetic response readouts, 768 assessment source units, fixed representations and raw/zero baselines, all models sealed before assessment generation. Independent saved-record audit passed with zero errors. Mixed pooled source-unit MAE 0.000762435 matched the equivalent-capacity raw-polynomial baseline; lossy/zero error was 0.302927979. All 15,360 supported pairs succeeded and all 3,072 support-stress pairs abstained, with no failed or unresolved assessment rows. Conditional unit-bootstrap uncertainty, source/artifact identities, resources and all outcomes are retained. This closes only the declared static synthetic evaluation; no real-world causal, individual-effect or inherited-encoder claim follows.

acceptance: The admitted protocol fixes data partitions, instance and artifact identities, baselines, budgets, selection policy, metrics and failure criteria before held-out assessment. Diagnostic exposure, changes and repeated looks are indexed; a revised protocol does not silently reuse an exposed confirmation set.

Report the declared evaluation unit, uncertainty or its justified limitation, coverage including abstentions and failures, and relevant resource costs. Index every initiated run and its outcome under foundations-evidence-ledger; do not discard unsuccessful or inconclusive evidence.

A valid completed evaluation can be negative or inconclusive. Milestone completion is not a positive claim verdict, and invalid or unexecuted attempts alone cannot satisfy operation-quality evaluation acceptance.

Match validators and uncertainty estimates to the declared claim level; unsupported identification or overlap triggers refusal of the intervention claim, not relabeling an observational comparison as causal.

goals.title: Expose Hx06 capabilities as a reusable toolset
goals.description: Expose the operations, validation, workflow building blocks and results developed within this Hero through a coherent toolset that applications and other operations can reuse across embedding providers. The delivered HX06-TOOLSET 0.2.0 surface provides common discovery, explicit input packaging, checking, recorded comparison, composition and verified result reuse through CLI and library APIs, preserving contracts, dependencies and claim limits. The current goal completes the selected engineering coverage; future observational/intervention profiles and representation-contribution studies retain their separate goals and will extend this boundary when implemented. Linux/Docker execution, the C++ engine and the Windows launcher describe the implementation environment.

milestones.title: Deliver and verify the Docker-based paired-response tool
milestones.description: Delivered a common CLI and reusable Node API with discovery, complete request schemas, byte-bound input inventories, explicit read-only checking, execution and saved-result inspection. The C++20 comparison engine compiles and runs inside the existing mityane-geometrics Linux Docker container; Node/Bash also run there, and tools.ps1 only forwards Windows commands through container.ps1. Hx06 is the first registered tool; its numerical implementation remains under counterfactuals. All 17 tool-boundary tests and 47 existing conformance cases passed, including distinct provider identities/widths, generic JavaScript non-pair runtime reuse, refusals, denominator preservation and tamper detection. The Windows workflow passed with relative and absolute paths. This completes the recorded-response tool scope; constructing alternatives and executing embedding/response models remain upstream responsibilities. The frozen synthetic study was preserved without replay and other Heroes were not migrated.
acceptance: One common command-line entry and reusable library expose discover/describe, check, run and inspect using versioned request and result envelopes; each operation retains its own payload and compatibility rules.

The C++20 engine builds and executes in the existing managed Linux Docker container. Supporting Node/Bash code also runs there; the PowerShell entry performs host orchestration only and the verified Windows workflow supports repository-relative and absolute Windows paths.

The same paired-response tool accepts two independent engineering provider identities and different representation widths, with manually verified contrasts and explicit incompatible-space, unsupported-claim and support-refusal outcomes.

Loaders verify actual referenced bytes and response-value bindings, reject malformed or incomplete records, retain the requested roster and all admitted states, and publish new inspectable bundles without overwriting existing output.
A separate non-pair JavaScript engineering adapter exercises the shared calling boundary; no extra operation capability or scientific result is inferred from that fixture.

milestones.description: Delivered and independently reviewed HX06-TOOLSET 0.2.0: explicit byte-bound request preparation, reusable recorded-alternative composition, verified structured result loading and discoverable complete output schemas through the common CLI/library. Define typed failure or abstention for malformed or incompatible records, prohibited or unavailable matching information and inadequate support; retain the complete requested population and refusal accounting without promoting association to an identified intervention effect.

goals.title: Resolve representation contribution
goals.description: The original frozen synthetic study tied fitted-readout MAE with an equivalent-capacity raw-polynomial control at 0.000762435. The completed separately admitted follow-up varies nonlinear representation families at equal input information and five-parameter TRAIN-only head budgets, reports every axis/population/seed/change group, and shows task-dependent feature/readout compatibility rather than universal encoder value. The binding policy is revised: OLS remains a scoped reference, with validation and a decision link required before any dependent profile uses it.

milestones.title: Re-run the comparison with capacity-matched representation families
milestones.description: Completed OR06-REP-CONTRIB-001 1.0.0: five fixed feature families, three response axes, three fresh protected populations and 45 sealed TRAIN-only readouts. Four families retain identical raw information and equal five-parameter head/fitting budgets; the lossy family is an explicit adverse control. Distinct nonlinear spans are not claimed to have equal total function classes. Exposure corrections and engineering failures are retained; 69,120 assessment requests reconcile to 57,600 successes and 11,520 stress abstentions, with zero failures/unresolved pairs and zero audit errors. The original study and its eight maintained file hashes remain unchanged.
acceptance: Predeclare genuinely different representation families and raw/simple-descriptor controls with matched accessible information, readout expressive capacity, fitting/selection budgets and evaluation populations. Distinguish changes in information content, geometry and downstream model capacity rather than attributing all differences to the encoder.

Freeze a new identified protocol and bound instance record, actual data/provider/model identities, splits, seeds, change definitions, metrics, coverage and failure criteria before assessment. Use fresh protected assessment populations, retain prior-exposure records, and preserve the original protocol, artifacts and source capsule unchanged.

Record actual admission, execution and all seeds, failures, abstentions and valid negative or inconclusive outcomes. Reusing the original score alone or changing polynomial degree alone cannot complete this comparison.

milestones.title: Report per-axis and per-population representation contribution
milestones.description: Reported all 864 assessment metric cells across three seeds plus pooled, three axes, twelve source/change groups and six families/baselines, alongside complete coverage and 864 descriptive development cells. Every non-stress assessment cell has 1,000 finite paired source-block bootstrap resamples; stress-only MAE/intervals are null. Raw polynomial suffices on the polynomial task, Fourier/hinge features help their aligned tasks, and negative/inconclusive comparisons and population/direction reversals remain visible. The evidence concerns fixed synthetic feature/readout compatibility, not a learned encoder or a distance-geometry advantage.
acceptance: Predeclare response-axis definitions, population/group strata and perturbation magnitude/direction breakdowns before protected assessment, or clearly label later analyses exploratory. Attach representation/encoder, readout, source population and horizon identities to every reported comparison.

Report paired baseline differences, per-axis and per-population errors, dependence-aware uncertainty and complete success/failure/abstention coverage for every selected family and seed; retain negative and inconclusive outcomes without selecting only favorable axes or populations.

Separate evidence of added predictive signal from mere invertible feature reparameterization or readout-capacity differences. State where the representation is redundant with a simple descriptor and where any contribution is supported only within the measured population.
